'''Module Organ Synths''' are crafting components used to create the [[Relay Tower|Relay Structure]], [[Module Genic Receptacle|Module Genic Receptacles]], and most bundle [[Modules]]. They have no use outside of this.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Crafting one Module Organ Synth requires five Iron Ingots, two of any Glass, one Redstone Dust, and one of either a [[Noxious Brain]], [[Toxic Lung]], [[Altered Tendons]], or [[Diseased Heart]].{{CraftingTable|r1_a1=Iron Ingot|r1_b1=Iron Ingot|r1_c1=Iron Ingot|r1_a2=Glass|r1_b2=Noxious Brain|r1_c2=Glass|r1_a3=Iron Ingot|r1_b3=Redstone Dust|r1_c3=Iron Ingot|r1_output=Module Organ Synth|r1_count=1}}
